method: Written by hand from one frame per second (frame round(s * fps) of clip.mp4), viewed with a pixel grid. Not from YOLO or any other detector.
camera: handheld: pans right; the bird's box moves about 300 px over the clip (tracked corners report 108 px; the hood is too smooth to track)
notes: One gull on a car hood from the first frame to the last; ivy leaves in the foreground at 0-1 s.

birds.notes: young gull sitting on the hood at the windshield, still for the whole clip; the camera pans, so its box moves right by about 300 px
